title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
short_summary: After her parents die, sour and lonely Mary Lennox is sent from India to live with her reclusive uncle at Misselthwaite Manor in Yorkshire. Wandering the manor's grounds, she discovers a garden that has been locked and hidden away for ten years — and slowly begins to bring it back to life.
extended_summary:
After her parents die, sour and lonely Mary Lennox is sent from India to live with her reclusive uncle at Misselthwaite Manor in Yorkshire. Wandering the manor's grounds, she discovers a garden that has been locked and hidden away for ten years — and slowly begins to bring it back to life.

With the help of Dickon, a boy who seems to be able to talk to animals, Mary secretly restores the garden. She also discovers her sickly cousin Colin, hidden away in his room and believed too weak to ever walk. As the garden blooms again, Mary and Colin both grow healthier and happier — and even Mary's grieving uncle is finally drawn back to life by what the children have done.
